changed_behavior.summary: The installation broker exposes bounded read-only repository branch discovery, snapshot browse/search, and merge-base comparison behind git.repository.read. The legacy bridge keeps its exact-root tool and OAuth surface. Snapshot reads use exact branch refs, main-worktree ownership, authorized ignore policy, no replacement objects, fail-closed partial/promisor checks, literal paths, sensitive rename-pair filtering, bounded pagination, and no external diff/textconv execution.

decisions: CHANGE-005 is the authoritative work source and its latest plan-review evidence is the contract baseline.
The task uses the C2C project alias and the local chat-to-codex repository, not the unrelated empty Windows browser-workspace directory.
The repository has no local dirty-path tracker; the compatible shared tracker fallback is retained in the manifest metadata.
The first implementation slice reuses resolveLocalWorktree(kind=main), runGit sanitization, and authorized main-workspace IgnoreRules instead of introducing parallel ownership or policy abstractions.
The broker MCP boundary resolves registered workspace ids before invoking the main-worktree repository owner resolver; linked-worktree-only registrations therefore fail closed.
constraints: Preserve every pre-existing path in task-ownership.json and do not normalize unrelated line endings.
Do not add checkout, worktree creation, fetch, network, shell execution, persistent snapshot state, or arbitrary revision parsing.
Do not push, open a pull request, deploy, or broaden CHANGE-005 scope.
risks: The current main worktree contains extensive unrelated dirty changes, including overlapping auth and broker files; ownership claims must remain exact.
The baseline diff check is already red because of pre-existing line-ending changes outside the first slice.
